name: wds_objectnet
description: A version of ObjectNet packaged as a webdataset (WDS) for large-scale evaluation. ObjectNet is an out-of-distribution image classification benchmark designed to test robustness of object-recognition models under varied poses, backgrounds, and contexts not seen during ImageNet training. It is used to evaluate model generalization and robustness rather than in-domain accuracy.
reputation: Well-known robustness/OOD benchmark in the computer-vision community and commonly used to assess ImageNet-trained models' generalization.
